contract.signature: from shipping import shipping_fee; shipping_fee(total_cents: int) -> int
rules: For nonnegative integer totals below 10000, return 500.
For integer totals at least 10000, return 0.
Type validation is out of scope.
contract.error_message: Unspecified; do not assert a message.

architecture: Keep public shipping module API and integer-cents contract. No new module, framework, persistence, IO seam, type guard, helper or abstraction required. Internal algorithm left to Implementer.

examples.covers: Immediately below threshold charges fixed fee

graph.readiness: Initial threshold ready; successors need current Green and affected regression for predecessor.
graph.final_gate: All three examples plus existing regression, independent test qualification, both review axes on one clean committed frozen candidate.

ownership.test_author: Exclusive writer of new/changed tests; blind context.
ownership.implementer: Exclusive product writer shipping.py; no test changes.
ownership.runner: Command prescription, causal interpretation, raw logs and neutral reports.
ownership.integrator: Only integration branch/index/runtime ledger writer; serialize phase transitions and ensure immutable snapshot bindings.
ownership.architect: Only architect-report.json and architect-test-safe-package.json; no tests/product edits.

integration: One serial flow in authoritative workspace; no overlapping writers or command observation during mutations. Preserve README and CURRENCY contract. Integrator uses approved plan with no gates; all current examples and regression affected by shipping.py changes.

budgets.capacity: One active command and one current phase writer.
budgets.basis: Tiny standard-library unittest suite; baseline regression reported exit 0. Thirty seconds is conservative containment, not business SLA.
budgets.stop_scope: Only owned command/process descendants; preserve evidence. Run caps stop affected execution; local diagnostics renewable on new material evidence.

execution: Use runtime execute for each prepared bounded command and batch only evidence-supported decided events. Distinct immutable Red and Green product bindings. Runner interprets actual target Red before implementation; first-run Green follows existing-capability path.
plan_change: No semantic changes to proposed-plan.json required. This report supplies ownership, readiness, boundary, budget and final acceptance detail.
blind_isolation: Initial blind participant inventory must exclude this implementation-visible report; supply only architect-test-safe-package.json plus enumerated authoritative inputs.
